QUOTE: Tool-only pattern (`filesystem.*`, `git.commit`): the part before `:` is matched against the fully qualified tool name. With no colon, every call to that tool matches, whatever its arguments.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the pattern is split at the colon into a tool part and an argument part, that fnmatch is used, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
